csv_allow_double_quotes.description: For CSV files: whether a double quote encloses a field. When false, it is an ordinary character.

file_format.description:
The format of the files. `infer` reads each file by its extension, and reads a folder that holds a `_delta_log` folder as a Delta table. `delta` needs the folder of a Delta table, without wildcards.

* `infer` - Infer from the file names
* `csv` - CSV with a header row
* `csv_no_header` - CSV without a header row
* `jsonl` - JSON Lines
* `parquet` - Parquet
* `delta` - Delta table

id.description: A UUID string identifying this external data source.

name.description: Name of the new table in the source. Starts with a letter or underscore, and contains only letters, numbers and underscores. Must not be the name of another table in the source.

path.description: Where the table's files are. Use a path inside the folder of the source's files URL, such as `events/`, `events/2026/*.parquet` or `data/file.csv`, or a full URL inside that folder. A folder reads every file under it. Wildcards use ClickHouse glob syntax. An empty path reads the whole folder. A source whose files URL names one file or a pattern can't add tables.
